title: How to Prepare a Songwriting Project Before Hiring
h1: How to prepare a songwriting project before hiring
description: Prepare a songwriting project: purpose, style, lyrics ideas, references, vocals, rights and what a songwriter or custom song service should deliver.
intro: Hiring a songwriter can give you an original song for a brand, a video, a gift, a game or your own music career. The result depends on how clearly you explain what you want and what you are allowed to do with the finished song. This article explains how to prepare, what to share and what to settle about rights before the work starts.

faq.q: What do I need to give a songwriter?
faq.a: The purpose of the song, the style, the mood, key words or stories for the lyrics and examples of songs you like.
That is something to agree in writing. Some services transfer full rights, others keep some rights or grant a license.
Often yes. Ask whether the songwriter sings, hires a vocalist, or whether you will provide the voice.
Some songwriters provide a rough demo first. Ask what stage you will hear before final delivery.
Simple custom songs can be quick, while fully produced tracks take longer. Ask for a timeline with milestones.
